name: Eastbourne

neighbourhoods.name: Town Centre
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian and Edwardian terraces and large villas, many split into flats, with flats over shops.

neighbourhoods.name: Meads
neighbourhoods.housing: A district of large Victorian villas, many converted to flats, and purpose-built blocks near the Downs.

neighbourhoods.name: Old Town
neighbourhoods.housing: The original village, with old flint cottages, Victorian terraces and inter-war houses.

neighbourhoods.name: Seaside
neighbourhoods.housing: A dense area of Victorian terraces near the seafront, many divided into flats.

neighbourhoods.name: Sovereign Harbour
neighbourhoods.housing: A marina development of modern flats and houses built from the 1990s.

neighbourhoods.name: Langney
neighbourhoods.housing: Large post-war and later estates of houses and low-rise flats.

neighbourhoods.name: Hampden Park
neighbourhoods.housing: A suburb of inter-war and post-war semis and terraces.

neighbourhoods.name: Ratton
neighbourhoods.housing: A suburb of larger inter-war and post-war detached houses.

housing: Eastbourne is a seaside town with a large stock of Victorian and Edwardian houses, many of them converted to flats, especially in the town centre, Seaside and Meads. Purpose-built flats line much of the seafront, and Sovereign Harbour adds modern marina housing. Langney and Hampden Park are mainly post-war estates and suburbs. The town has an older population than average and many retirement flats.
checkinTips: Flats in converted Victorian villas: photograph sash windows, the communal hall and stairs, fire doors and smoke alarms, and note key and fob counts.
Seafront flats: photograph window frames, balcony rails and outside metalwork for salt corrosion, and any damp on outside walls.
Purpose-built blocks: photograph the lift, bin store and entry system, and note fob and key counts and any service charge rules given to the tenant.
Sovereign Harbour homes: photograph balconies, parking spaces and gate fobs, and note marina or estate rules given to the tenant.
Flats over shops in the town centre: photograph the separate entrance, stairs and fire doors, and note the key count for each door.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact Eastbourne Borough Council's private sector housing team, which can inspect rented homes and take action against landlords.
